item.title: Stanhope hires Mace to bring forward £450m South Bank office scheme
item.description: Development and asset manager Stanhope has appointed Mace Construct as main contractor to build its Bankside office scheme, with a £450m gross development value, on the South Bank in central London.

item.title: Hines and Chancerygate land Investec loan for £39m Oldham logistics scheme
item.description: Investec Bank has provided a senior development loan to Hines and Chancerygate to fund a 166,500 sq ft speculative urban logistics development in Oldham.

item.title: Future Homes Standard rules delayed until 2028
item.description: The long-awaited Future Homes Standard has been published today (24 March), setting out new energy efficiency requirements for low-carbon housing, but its implementation has been delayed until March 2028.

item.title: SENG secures £65.5m loan for two London office conversions
item.description: Specialist lenders ASK and Firma Partners have provided a £65.5m senior loan for private investor SENG's acquisition of the Regents House office building in London's Islington and its conversion of Chiswick Tower.

item.title: Final phase of Get Living’s £1.5bn Elephant and Castle scheme approved
item.description: Built-to-rent (BTR) giant Get Living has secured planning approval for the final phase of its £1.5bn Elephant and Castle redevelopment masterplan in south London, including 507 BTR homes.

item.title: Avison Young makes 44 senior promotions across the business
item.description: Global real estate adviser Avison Young has announced 44 senior promotions across the business at associate director and director levels.

item.title: New rules to force planning authorities to consult Reed if rejecting schemes over 150 homes
item.description: Local planning authorities (LPA) will be required notify housing secretary Steve Reed if they intend to reject a planning application with at least 150 homes, under imminent new rules.

item.title: Montagu Evans announces largest-ever round of promotions
item.description: Montagu Evans has unveiled its largest-ever round of promotions involving 35 people across the business, as part of its growth strategy.

item.title: New Future Homes Standard raises viability worries
item.description: Industry experts have welcomed the publication of the Future Homes Standard as providing greater certainty for housebuilders, but warned it could lumber smaller developers with insurmountable viability hurdles.

item.title: Cost of building London skyscrapers up 40% since 2020, report shows
item.description: The construction of tall buildings in the capital costs 40% more than it did six years ago, outstripping increases in other major cities, according to a report by professional services provider Turner & Townsend.

item.title: Arini lends easyStorage £180m for UK roll-out
item.description: Self-storage operator easyStorage, part of easyJet owner easyGroup, has raised £180m from lender Arini to support a UK expansion programme.

item.title: C&W’s Court to retire after 36 years with the firm
item.description: Yvonne Court, Cushman & Wakefield’s (C&W) international partner and head of its EMEA cross border retail and leisure team, will retire at the end of this month after more than 36 years with the firm.

item.title: Industry alarmed by plan to ban retention practice in late payment crackdown
item.description: Property and construction experts have warned about the potential impact of a proposed ban on retention payments, a sum withheld from a contractor to ensure project completion, as part of a government clampdown on late payments to small businesses.

item.title: Criterion Capital to develop flagship Zedwell hotel at London's Bank Junction
item.description: Criterion Capital, controlled by developer and landlord Asif Aziz, is to open a flagship Zedwell-branded hotel at 1 Princes Street in the City of London.

item.title: IM Properties launches appeal to develop £343m Warwickshire business park
item.description: The government is set to determine whether IM Properties can build a 3m sq ft business park near Birmingham, after the Midlands developer lodged a planning appeal following a delay in determining its application.
